name: 药师
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept character redesign. Image1 is the user's approved unified STYLE AND COMPACT PROPORTION sample. Image2 is the previous identity/theme reference, NOT a costume to trace. Redesign the named subject into a distinctive new Chinese game character design using the direction below. Keep recognizable identity/theme, gender/age, palette and key props but intentionally refresh costume tailoring, silhouette rhythm, hair shape and personality-specific pose. Never clone the female blade sample's red outfit/face/hair across the cast. Match image1's bold controlled contours, coherent large gem-icon handpainted planes, 2-4 simple material shadows, graphic cartoon eyes with one small highlight max, no fragmented triangle mosaic, realistic eyes or 3D gloss. Humans approximately the SAME compact crown-to-sole head/body ratio as image1 (about four heads excluding hair/hats), retaining reasonable lean/stocky identity differences, no long-legged six-head fashion proportions. All women clearly adult, attractive natural full feminine curves and tailored garments but agile rather than heavy/barrel-thick; men retain distinct age/physique. Faces and bodies three-quarter facing SCREEN LEFT. Mild dynamic weight shift, two anatomically coherent separate legs and both feet readable, no parallel stiff pose or hidden extra leg. Props and hands structurally correct. Entire single full-body subject and ALL props safely inside a square canvas with 8% margins. Plain warm ivory #F4EFDF background, no shadows/scene/text/panels/extra people. Strong broad shape contrast, detail concentrated in only one or two zones. SPECIFIC DESIGN: 药师：成年女性，温柔有主见，圆润笑眼但成熟，柔和丰满曲线不过分粗厚。黑色低后盘髻配两片叶饰，区别高马尾。米白、鼠尾草绿与木棕。全新短圆弧云肩、米白斜交领束腰衣、圆弧层叠及膝裙片覆束口宽裤，绿布鞋。图形方向为圆形、椭圆和大柔和弧线。怀抱木棕双腹药葫芦一片叶标，另一手提草药布袋肩带，简洁背药篓两卷药卷。叶子、药包不堆碎，多留大白面。微侧重心、脚踝与双鞋清楚。
